items.check_item: INDICATOR LIGHT — Check the status of the machine indicator light. Replace it promptly if damaged.
INNER CHAMBER CLEANING — Use the standard PM program to clean the inner chamber.
EJECTOR ROD — Check whether the ejector rod is deformed. Replace it promptly if deformation is found.
CHAMBER LEAK — Check the exhaust for oil leakage. Stop and repair any leak promptly. Loosen the relief screw, drain the waste oil from the pump, then reinstall and tighten the screw (oil pump only).
FEED BELT — Check the condition of the feed belt (VSP-88D PRO1 only).
GASKET — Check sealing tightness. Replace the gasket if damaged or defective.

VACUUM PUMP — Drain the residual oil, add new oil to the lower oil-level limit, and run the cleaning procedure. Repeat two or three times until the discharged oil returns to its normal color, then fill to two-thirds of the oil-level mark.
FILTER CHECK — Check whether the inlet filter is contaminated and replace it when necessary.
CAVITY ORBIT — Check the track-wall condition and confirm that the inner wall is smooth (VSP-88D PRO1 only).
DRIVE BELT, DRIVE SHAFT AND GEAR — Check the transmission shaft and gear condition and confirm they are not damaged (VSP-88D PRO1 only).

ESD RESISTANCE — Confirm: (1) rail-to-loader resistance is below 10 ohms; (2) rail-to-unloader resistance is below 10 ohms; (3) loader-to-unloader resistance is below 10 ohms (VSP-88H excepted); and (4) ground-to-chamber-door lock-latch resistance is below 10 ohms.
